scores.evidence: Every pillar carries a decision tag, and the three views (line, exposure, fit) map onto the GOAL cadences. Cash-flow routing (FIT01, FIT02) answers the owner's 'pool' question directly. The weakness is the weekly composite in scoring_method step 8. It sums family scores that use three different references: the sleeve median for CST/TAX/DUR, VWRA for EXR/FAC/RSK/CON/MOM, and the current portfolio for FIT. It then ranks all 322 lines on that sum. The cross-sleeve ranking the owner will read has no decision meaning. A line in a weak sleeve scores 50 on line cost simply because it is the sleeve median. Many pillars are display only (CON02, CON03, MOM05, FAC05, MAC01, MAC02, RSK09), which is acceptable for the weekly review but thins the 'every pillar decides something' claim.

The citations fit the horizon used. Cost and tracking difference: Sharpe 1991, Elton et al. 2002. CAPE at 10-15 years, with its weakness at 1 year noted. Long-term reversal replaces the old wrong-signed CAGR pillars (De Bondt-Thaler). Hype penalty: Ben-David et al. 2023. Macro is weight 0 per Welch-Goyal. Momentum is down-weighted per McLean-Pontiff and this system's own failed S3. Cash-flow rebalancing: Jaconetti et al. Remaining soft spots are calibration, not evidence: the tanh k scales, the 55/15 tilt thresholds and the 0.98/50 bp splice test are pre-registered but uncalibrated.

Momentum is now counted once and withholding is no longer double-counted (CST02 beyond TER, TAX01/TAX02 dropping out after 3 years of TD), which is a real fix. Value is now counted several times instead: EXR01 CAPE yield, EXR02 CAPE vs own history, EXR03 multi-ratio (which also contains E/P), EXR08 long-term reversal (described as 'the price-based value proxy') and FAC01 HML. That is about 45% of EXR plus FAC01, roughly 10 of 100 points on one idea. Restricted-market risk enters three times: CON04 scored, CON04 above 5% as a gate, and an EVT07 penalty in the exposure score. RSK01, RSK02, RSK04 and RSK05 are all drawdown or underperformance-spell measures, likely to be highly correlated. CON01 penalises fund-level concentration while FIT09 caps it at portfolio level, a residual of the double count the merge removed for CON02/CON03. DUR01 and DUR02 overlap. The universe also has duplicate rows (CUSS.L, R2US.L, WSML.L, XDEW.L), so '322 lines' is 318 unique, and XDEW has conflicting scope (us/equal_weight) and TER (0.20/0.15).

All required areas are covered. Expected return: EXR01-EXR11. Risk: RSK01-RSK08. Cost: CST01-CST10. Tax: TAX01-TAX05 plus EVT06. Durability: DUR01-DUR08. Diversification and fit with holdings: FIT03-FIT11. Valuation: EXR. Macro: MAC01-MAC04. News and events: EVT01-EVT10. Owner-specific items are also present: the AED peg (MAC04, EVT08), the US$2 FX minimum (REC05), whole-share residue (CST08), the GBp line trap (ELG02) and Canadian residency rules (EVT06).

Prices, iShares holdings, TER and TD tables, FRED, Shiller via shillerdata.com and Ken French are verified. But much of the EXR family, the main tilt driver at weight 20, rests on sources that failed or do not exist:
- EXR01 regional CAPE: Research Affiliates is a JS app, StarCapital redirects, Barclays needs a login.
- EXR02: non-US history missing.
- EXR04: S&P DJI buyback pages return 403, and accumulating .L lines give no yield.
- EXR05: config/cma.csv does not exist.
FIT04 (40% of FIT and a qualification condition for targets) depends on these.

Several source_status labels say 'verified' against the probe results:

- CST02, CST07 and DUR02 are verified only for iShares, while the core VWRA is a Vanguard line whose TD, NAV and share-class AUM are unverified.

Owner-input pillars (ELG08, CST09, REC01, REC05, REC06) have no schema in portfolio.yaml and no upload location. DUR05 (justETF lists 404) and DUR08 (no KID history, EVT04 not built) are correctly marked unverified. Half weight for unverified sources mitigates this, so it is feasible with fixes.

Strong on the UCITS mechanics: the IE/LU gate, USD-line mapping with the GBp trap (ELG02), whole-share residue (VUAA US$143.90 and XNAS US$63.16 instead of CSPX US$802.21 and CNDX US$1,562.80, confirmed in the universe files), at most 2 orders of at least US$340, and the worked example arithmetic checks out (gap S&P +2,068, VWRA -2,422, 4 x 143.90 + 1.70, residue 102.70).

Problems:
(1) ELG01 requires 'the fund is UCITS'. IGLN.L and SGLD.L (scope gold_physical_etc) are Irish-issued ETC debt securities, not UCITS funds. So the gold sleeve either can never be bought or ELG01 is silently not applied, and ELG04 contradicts ELG01.
(2) Sleeve lines named in the allocation are missing from the universe: EQAC (only EQQU.L exists, at US$665), EXUS, and the core alternatives SPYY and ACWD that DECISION_RULES names. CST10 and DUR06 cannot score them.
(3) The US$2 FX minimum (about 29 bps per deposit) exceeds the commission. It is only logged (REC05), not handled in the routing rule. Converting every two months, or holding USD residue, is not a rule option.
(4) Step (a) says 'about US$680 after the US$2 FX minimum', but 2,500 / 3.6725 = 680.74, so it is about 678.7 after the fee. Minor.

Most pillars have closed-form definitions, and agents are limited to cited events with fixed severity-to-score maps. The exception is the most important fit pillar. FIT04 defines alpha_i = E[R_i - R_f] - beta x E[R_P - R_f] with 'expected excess returns from the EXR blend'. But the EXR blend is a 0-100 tanh score built from mixed units (yields in %, z-scores, a percentile, bps drags). No mapping from score to an expected return in % is given. FIT04 therefore cannot be computed deterministically, yet it gates every satellite target and is the only route for gold. Other gaps:
- 'Approved equivalent' index tables (ELG07, DUR06) and the treaty and rules tables (TAX02, TAX04) are hand-kept with no named owner or version.
- The CON04 list is maintained by an agent (EVT07), so an agent sets a scored input.
- EXR05 region mapping and the GMO real-to-nominal +2.5% are fixed constants, which is acceptable if logged.

Weekly scoring, monthly routing and quarterly targets is a sound layering for a 15-year goal, and smoothing (4-week median, 13-week mean, 2 consecutive quarters, at most 5 points per quarter) stops weekly noise from moving money. Mismatch: MOM01 and MOM02 (a 3-12 month signal) sit inside X, which needs two consecutive quarterly qualifications plus hysteresis. A tilt can take 6-9 months to build, by which time the momentum reading is stale. The weight is small (4), but the score is noise at that horizon. The 'first targets from backfilled scores' sentence also conflicts with the 2-consecutive-quarters rule.

The anti-low-volatility design is good: ELG04 excludes cash, risk pillars are one-sided or scale-free, cash gets 0 in FIT04, and FIT06 rewards volatile diversifiers. Cash-flow rebalancing toward fixed targets also avoids the S5 timing coin flip. However:
(a) The rule that actually moves money is the X >= 55 tilt to quarterly targets. It is untested, yet satellites may take up to 20% of the portfolio before REC04 passes. That contradicts GOAL ('any rule that moves money must be backtested ... and beat holding the world under both execution assumptions') and DECISION_RULES rule 2, which defaults satellite_share to 0 and caps the satellite share of each deposit, not the portfolio, at 20%. The candidate also routes 100% of a deposit to a satellite sleeve for months.
(b) REC04 tests a different rule from the live one. It covers only the backtestable subset, and even that is not computable as written: 'US CAPE against the world' needs a world CAPE history the data probes found unavailable.
(c) The FIT04 qualification condition is undefined (see criterion 7).
(d) The weekly composite sums scores with three different references (sleeve median, VWRA, portfolio), so cross-sleeve ranking is not meaningful.
(e) Unverified pillars still move money at half weight rather than zero.

Point-in-time logging is well specified. REC02 snapshots every deposit including record-only and MAC pillars; REC03 measures live IC with a promotion bar of t > 2 after 36 months; REC04 runs both execution timings with deflated Sharpe; REC01 tracks the VWRA shadow. Gaps:
- Most of X cannot be backtested (EXR03, EXR05, EXR09, CON01, CON05, EVT03, EVT04, EVT07), so the live tilt can only be validated by REC03.
- REC03 computes IC 'across eligible lines'. Many lines share one index (CSPX, VUAA and SPXS; VWRA, FWRA and ISAC), which inflates the cross-section and the t-statistic. The decision is made per sleeve (about 8), so power at quarterly frequency is very low.
- REC03 halves a family's weight on IC <= 0 after 52 weeks, a noisy one-year test.
- No pre-registered test exists for the line rule (CST10 choice) beyond the REC06 regret log.

blocking: Criterion 9: the money-moving tilt rule (X >= 55 then target = band max x clip((X-55)/15)) can put up to 20% of the portfolio into satellites before REC04 passes. Criterion 9 / 7: FIT04 (40% of FIT and a required condition for every satellite target, including gold) derives E[R] from 'the EXR blend'. That is a 0-100 score in mixed units with no defined mapping to a % return, so the qualification test cannot be computed deterministically.

scores.evidence: Every pillar carries a decision tag, and the three views map cleanly onto the GOAL cadences. Line score plus CST10 picks the line, exposure score sets the quarterly targets, FIT01 gaps route the monthly deposit, S0-S6 cover sells, and REC01-REC06 keep the testing record. Context-only pillars (MOM04, MOM05, RSK09, MAC01-MAC04) feed the weekly note and are explicitly kept away from money. The one weak spot is the weekly composite across all 322 lines. It sums three different references (sleeve median, VWRA and current portfolio), so it has no single meaning, but it is labelled display-only.

Citations are mostly appropriate to the horizon: CAPE at 10-15 years, a 5-year reversal window, Ben-David 2023 for CON05, Petajisto for EXR09, and a 60-month window for the FAC loadings. Four gaps remain. (a) MOM01 and MOM02 still carry 4 points in the exposure score that sets targets, but the repo's own S3 failed the gate and lost 4-6% a year in 2015-19. (b) EXR09's front-running parameters come from Petajisto 2011 and have shrunk since. (c) RSK06 and EXR07 rest on weak or regime-dependent evidence. (d) The value-type signals together (EXR01, EXR02, EXR03, EXR05, EXR08, FAC01) amount to an ex-US value tilt that lost 2010-2025. The set never says that its own evidence implies the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 sleeves will almost never qualify, with US CAPE at 40.7 (Shiller 2026.10).

Momentum is counted once (MOM01 and MOM02, 4 points) and the TER/TD/withholding double count is fixed. Valuation, however, is now the multiply-counted factor. EXR01 (1/CAPE), EXR02 (CAPE z-score), EXR03 (whose E/P component is close to 1/CAPE across markets), EXR05 (RA and GMO CMAs are explicit CAPE mean-reversion models) and EXR08 (5-year reversal, the price-based value proxy in AMP 2013) together hold 0.60 of EXR, or 12 composite points. Add FAC01 HML and value is about 28% of the exposure score. FIT03 overlap, FIT07 US weight, FIT08 sector, FIT09 single name and FIT10 tracking error are all monotone in the same S&P/Nasdaq weight, so one addition is penalised up to five times. That contradicts the stated CON02/CON03 de-duplication. DUR01 and DUR02 are identical for single-share-class funds such as CSPX. CST06 traded value and DUR01 AUM are strongly related. No pre-launch correlation matrix is given, and REC03's |rho|>0.85 check only runs after 13 weeks. The old set had 59 such pairs, and this one has not been shown to be clean.

All required areas are present. Expected return: EXR01-EXR11. Risk: RSK01-RSK08. Cost: CST01-CST10. Tax: TAX01-TAX05. Durability: DUR01-DUR08. Diversification and fit with holdings: FIT03-FIT11. Valuation: EXR01-EXR03 and EXR11. Macro: MAC01-MAC04, at weight 0. News and events: EVT01-EVT10. Bond and gold sleeves get their own valuation pillars (EXR10, EXR11).

Many money-relevant inputs fail the source tests. ELG08 has no schema in portfolio.yaml. DUR05 fails because the justETF closure and provider URLs return 404. DUR07 fails because Invesco returns 406 and the Xtrackers API is empty. DUR08 has no history and EVT04 does not exist. EXR04 fails on both halves: buybacks return 403, and accumulating UCITS lines give no yield. EXR05 has no cma.csv. EXR01 has no regional CAPE. EXR02 non-US is missing. CST05 quotes are stale or crossed. REC01, REC05 and REC06 have no owner uploads. Several pillars carry status labels the tests contradict. EXR04 claims a verified dividend yield, but accumulating lines read 0 or null. CON01 cites SSGA as verified, but the brief lists it as unverified. EXR01 cites the Shiller file without noting that the Yale URL is stale and that shillerdata.com has to be scraped. The decisive problem: VWRA is about 38% non-US, and EXR01 needs non-US CAPE, so it cannot be computed even for the reference. With EXR01, EXR02, EXR04 and EXR05 at half weight or missing, 45% of EXR rests on unverified sources, and FIT04 inherits that. The half-weight rule and coverage gate keep this at 2 rather than 1.

The cost and execution details match UAE and IBKR reality. The checks below were confirmed against the universe files and portfolio.yaml:
- The US$1.70 commission is in the line choice, and a second order only goes ahead at US$340 or more each, so there are at most 2 orders a month.
- The US$2 FX minimum is costed at about 29 bps, which is correct for US$680.
- CST08 handles whole-share residue and routes around CSPX (about US$802) and CNDX (about US$1,563) to VUAA and XNAS.
- ELG02 catches GBp lines, and ELG01 enforces IE domicile with the treaty and estate-tax rationale.
- Residue carries over by at most one month.
- The VWRA TER of 0.19 in the universe file and the SPXS price of 14.95 were both confirmed in config/universe_ucits_equity_global_regional.csv, and ELG10 flags the TER mismatch.
- The 322-line count matches the 4 universe CSVs (326 rows minus 4 headers).

The code pillars are deterministic, and their tanh scales are pre-registered. Two agent outputs still move money on judgement. EVT03's intact, weakened or broken verdict changes the exposure score (40 or 25) and can freeze a sleeve, from qualitative facts such as 'Japanese governance reform' or 'Taiwan risk'. The EVT01, EVT02, EVT05 and EVT07 severity levels gate deposits and open S1. EVT10 has an agent typing CMA and CAPE numbers into cma.csv and cape.csv with no code check, so a hallucinated or mis-mapped figure flows straight into EXR05, FIT04 and the targets. FIT04 says expected excess returns 'come from the EXR blend', but no deterministic mapping from a 0-100 score to a % return is defined.

The cadences fit: a weekly display, a 4-week median for monthly decisions, and a 13-week mean plus 2 consecutive quarters for targets, matching 10-15 year pillars. The testing loop does not fit. REC03 cuts a family's weight by half after 52 weeks if its 13- or 52-week IC is 0 or below. By the candidate's own evidence, EXR (CAPE explains under 5% at 1 year) and FAC have near-zero IC at those horizons, so REC03 would demote the long-horizon family on noise. After 52 weeks a 52-week horizon gives only one non-overlapping observation.

There are good parts: gates keep cash out (ELG04), the one-sided RSK and FIT pillars cannot reward calm funds, deposits rebalance by cash flow with no rotation, and S0 bans trend selling. The money-moving rule still conflicts with the evidence.
(a) Satellites can receive up to 20% of the portfolio now, through targets from the exposure score X, before REC04 has passed any gate. DECISION_RULES sets satellite_share to 0 because no tested rule beats holding, and GOAL requires every money-moving rule to be backtested first. The clip((X-55)/15) rule has never been tested. With about 6 sleeves and about 44 quarterly decisions, REC04 has little power, so the 'pre-gate' 20% will in practice be the permanent rule.
(b) X is taken from each sleeve's best eligible line. That is max-of-N selection bias: sleeves with more lines (S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 have 3 each) get inflated X, so exposure should be scored on the index, not the line.
(c) The thresholds 55 and 15, the 2.5 and 5 point hysteresis, the bands and about 60 k scales were chosen after seeing the 2015-2026 backtest, while N_TRIALS stays at 8.
(d) Missing data is treated asymmetrically. US exposures have Shiller data and get scored down. Data-poor exposures shrink to 50, the same as VWRA, so they look relatively better by construction.
(e) FIT04 has no defined unit conversion from score to return.

Every pillar is snapshotted in REC02, and REC04 re-runs a subset monthly with deposits, costs, whole shares and both timings. The test design still has look-ahead and inference gaps.
- REC04 tests a different rule from the live one. It covers about half the exposure score, and 'US CAPE against the world' cannot be built without non-US CAPE history.
- The 'scores backfilled where the history allows' for first targets would use today's holdings, TER, AUM and revised Shiller, FRED and Ken French data, which is look-ahead. RSK01, RSK02 and RSK05 over the 'longest valid history' must use expanding windows at each date.
- The universe holds only today's 322 surviving lines (no closed-fund list), and the sleeves S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 were chosen after their run, which is survivorship and hindsight bias.
- REC03 pools about 322 lines, many tracking the same index, with overlapping 13- and 52-week windows. Its t-statistics are overstated unless it clusters by exposure and uses non-overlapping or Newey-West errors.
- CST family IC is measured against VWRA returns, but cost should be tested within a sleeve against the same-index peer's forward return gap.

blocking: Criterion 9: satellite sleeves can take up to 20% of the portfolio through X-driven targets before REC04 has passed any gate. GOAL and DECISION_RULES require every money-moving rule to beat holding VWRA in both sub-periods, under both timings, with deflated Sharpe probability above 0.95. The clip((X-55)/15) tilt rule has never been tested, and with about 6 sleeves REC04 will probably never have the power to pass, so the 'temporary' 20% becomes the permanent unvalidated rule.

Criterion 9: the exposure score X is taken from each sleeve's best eligible line (max of N). This inflates X for sleeves with more lines (S&P 500 has VUAA, CSPX and SPXS; Nasdaq-100 has XNAS, CNDX and EQAC), a selection bias that moves targets.

Criterion 9: the thresholds (55 and 15, the 2.5 and 5 point hysteresis, the bands, about 60 tanh scales) were fixed after the 2015-2026 backtest had been seen, yet N_TRIALS in src/backtest.py is still 8. Any later REC04 'pass' would be data-snooped.

Criterion 3: value is counted about 5 times. EXR01, EXR02, EXR03, EXR05 and EXR08 make up 0.60 of EXR, about 12 composite points, and FAC01 adds more, so value is about 28% of the exposure score. No pre-launch correlation matrix shows these are distinct.

Criterion 3: FIT03, FIT07, FIT08, FIT09 and FIT10 are all monotone in the same S&P 500 or Nasdaq-100 weight, so one purchase is penalised up to 5 times. DUR01 and DUR02 are identical for single-share-class funds.
Total is 21 of 30, below the 25 required.
fixes: Pre-gate satellite policy. While REC04 fails, X must not set satellite targets. Two options: (a) the owner sets static sleeve weights in config/portfolio.yaml (for example S&P 500 at 0-10%), logged as an owner policy choice and not a system signal, with FIT01 routing deposits to those fixed targets; or (b) X-driven targets are capped at 10% in total and run as a pre-registered live experiment, compared with the REC02 VWRA shadow. Raise to 20-30% only after the REC04 gate passes. State plainly in the owner note that the evidence currently supports VWRA as the default destination, and that S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 are allowed but not evidence-favoured.

Score each sleeve's exposure on its reference index or reference line (for example the S&P 500 index through the ELG07 splice), not the maximum over its lines. Line differences belong only in the line score and CST10.

Freeze a config hash (pillar_scales.yaml, thresholds, bands) before the first REC04 run. Raise N_TRIALS to count every tilt-rule variant considered across the four designs and the merge (at least the number of distinct threshold and weight sets). Report the effective number of independent sleeve decisions next to the deflated Sharpe.

Collapse the valuation cluster. Keep one equity valuation composite: EXR01 if regional CAPE becomes verified, otherwise EXR03. Fold EXR02 into it, or make it record-only. Set EXR05 to record-only (or use it only as a shrinkage target), because RA and GMO CMAs are CAPE-based. Keep EXR08 only if its measured rank correlation with the composite on the 9 sleeve proxies is below 0.7. Publish a pre-launch Spearman matrix of every scored pillar over the 322 lines and the sleeve proxies, and merge any pair with |rho| of 0.85 or more before launch rather than after 13 weeks (REC03).

In FIT, set FIT03 overlap to weight 0 as context, since the candidate's own evidence says active share does not predict returns. Keep FIT10 tracking error as the single scored active-risk measure, and treat FIT07, FIT08 and FIT09 as hard constraints with weight 0, not scored pillars.

Merge DUR01 and DUR02 into one size pillar using min(fund AUM, share-class AUM x 5), or score DUR02 only when the fund has several share classes. Drop CST06 from scoring above the saturation level, or merge it with CST05 and CST09 as one liquidity pillar.
Set MOM01 and MOM02 to record-only (weight 0) for quarterly targets until REC04 shows they add value inside the tilt rule. The repo's S3 failed the gate and lost 4-6% a year in 2015-19.

EXR01 and EXR02 data: VWRA's look-through 1/CAPE needs non-US CAPE, which is unverified, so EXR01 is undefined for the reference itself. Until config/cape.csv holds dated, cited regional CAPE, set EXR01 and EXR02 to missing for every exposure, including the US, so that US-only data does not bias the comparison. Read Shiller only from the scraped shillerdata.com link, not the stale Yale URL.

Correct the source_status labels. EXR04: unverified (accumulating UCITS yields read 0 or null, S&P DJI returns 403); use the proxy's trailing dividends, as the test showed for VT at 1.56%. CON01: drop SSGA as a verified source. DUR05, DUR07 and DUR08: unverified or failing, at half weight. ELG08: add the schema (units, cost, orderable flag, check date) to config/portfolio.yaml.

Make EVT10 harvests checkable by code. Each cma.csv and cape.csv row must carry a URL plus the quoted text span, and a parser fetches the page and confirms the number before EXR05 or EXR01 reads it. Otherwise the row is marked unverified (half weight) or missing.
